# Key numbers (auto-generated by run_all.py; every figure below comes from outputs/tables)

## Data

- 2023: 6,885 rows in the file; removed 3 empty-score, 0 zero-score, 0 other; kept 6,882.
- 2024: 4,381 rows in the file; removed 0 empty-score, 0 zero-score, 0 other; kept 4,381.
- 2025: 9,349 rows in the file; removed 0 empty-score, 12 zero-score, 0 other; kept 9,337.
- 2026-R1: 6,945 rows in the file; removed 11 empty-score, 1 zero-score, 0 other; kept 6,933.
- 2026-R2: 6,058 rows in the file; removed 1 empty-score, 7 zero-score, 0 other; kept 6,050.
- Valid candidate-attempts: 33,583; distinct candidates after linking: 21,129; 36.0% appear in two or more rounds; maximum 5 rounds.
- Pass mark: 216 in every round (no pass below it, no fail at or above it).

## Linking quality

- Matched records keep the same field of study in 99.89% of cases (random linking would give about 65%).
- In Part A rounds linked records keep the same institute in 99.81% of 7,547 pairs.
- Rank correlation of consecutive scores: 0.52 for linked pairs vs -0.07 after shuffling (false-link baseline).
- A typo-tolerant rule adds only 209 extra links and leaves conclusions unchanged (see linkage_sensitivity).

## Part B - five linked rounds

### Pass rate by round

- 2023: 30.1% (95% CI 29.0% to 31.2%), n=6,882, median candidate who failed was 68 points below the pass mark; first attempt 30.1%.
- 2024: 31.5% (95% CI 30.2% to 32.9%), n=4,381, median candidate who failed was 54 points below the pass mark; first attempt 46.4%, retaking 13.2% (45% of candidates retaking).
- 2025: 39.6% (95% CI 38.7% to 40.6%), n=9,337, median candidate who failed was 43 points below the pass mark; first attempt 43.5%, retaking 27.5% (24% of candidates retaking).
- 2026-R1: 11.1% (95% CI 10.4% to 11.9%), n=6,933, median candidate who failed was 70 points below the pass mark; first attempt 24.7%, retaking 3.9% (65% of candidates retaking).
- 2026-R2: 31.2% (95% CI 30.1% to 32.4%), n=6,050, median candidate who failed was 58 points below the pass mark; first attempt 49.2%, retaking 19.9% (61% of candidates retaking).

### After a failure

- Pooled over all consecutive rounds, 54.8% (CI 54.1% to 55.6%) of failed candidates came back in the next round, and 14.7% (CI 14.1% to 15.4%) of those who came back passed.
- 2023 > 2024: 40.6% came back; 12.7% of them passed; mean score change +10.6.
- 2024 > 2025: 53.9% came back; 30.2% of them passed; mean score change +33.9.
- 2025 > 2026-R1: 71.1% came back; 3.6% of them passed; mean score change -23.8.
- 2026-R1 > 2026-R2: 51.5% came back; 22.2% of them passed; mean score change +30.1.
- Chance of passing by number of previous failures (0/1/2/3+): 38.0% / 14.0% / 17.4% / 7.0%.
- Odds ratios of passing (M2, adjusted for round and field; cluster-robust CI): 1 previous failure: 0.29 (0.27-0.32); 2: 0.28 (0.25-0.31); 3+: 0.11 (0.09-0.14); 2026 R1 vs 2025: 0.31 (0.28-0.34).
- Scores persist between consecutive rounds: Pearson r from 0.59 to 0.82; mean change from -23.8 to +33.9 points depending on the round pair.
- 2024 to 2025: pass rate changed +8.1 points (composition +5.1, rate +3.0).
- 2025 to 2026-R1: pass rate changed -28.5 points (composition -7.6, rate -20.9).
- 2026-R1 to 2026-R2: pass rate changed +20.1 points (composition +1.0, rate +19.1).

### Persistence and heavy re-sitting

- Failed first attempt in 2023 (4,812 candidates): 60% came back, 15.8% eventually passed by 2026 R2.
- Failed first attempt in 2024 (1,293 candidates): 62% came back, 20.3% eventually passed by 2026 R2.
- Failed first attempt in 2025 (4,000 candidates): 77% came back, 11.4% eventually passed by 2026 R2.
- Failed first attempt in 2026-R1 (1,814 candidates): 43% came back, 16.5% eventually passed by 2026 R2.
- Share who passed at some point, by total attempts 1/2/3/4/5: 59% / 27% / 23% / 8% / 12% (survivorship: passers stop sitting).
- Median first-attempt score by total attempts 1/2/3/4/5: 225 / 166 / 169 / 148 / 153.

## Part A - three rounds with institution information (2025, 2026 R1, 2026 R2)

- Public: pass rate 71.4% (CI 69.4% to 73.4%), 2,867 attempts by 2,437 candidates.
- Private: pass rate 21.8% (CI 21.2% to 22.4%), 19,224 attempts by 12,152 candidates.
- Abroad: pass rate 59.0% (CI 52.0% to 66.8%), 227 attempts by 185 candidates.
- Public vs private odds ratio 9.0 (CI 8.2-9.8), Cramer V 0.37, Cliff delta 0.63.
- Private-institute graduates are 86% of candidates and 94% of all failures.
- Public-vs-private odds ratio among FIRST attempts by round (2025/2026 R1/2026 R2): 10.3 / 12.9 / 22.3.
- First attempts only, adjusted for round and field: private vs public OR 0.075 (CI 0.066-0.085); round 2026 R1 vs 2025 OR 0.25.
- Of 41 institutes with enough candidates, 13 did better and 14 did worse than their type, round and field predict (FDR 5%).
- Between-institute spread inside private institutes: SD of true pass rates 10 percentage points (chi-square p=2.5e-76).
- Share of first-attempt score variance explained (adjusted omega-squared): Institute type 22%, Province 9%, Institute 27%, Round 6%, Field 1%.
- Model-predicted pass chance (medicine): private first attempt 36% (2025), 10% (2026 R1), 34% (2026 R2); private after one failure 5% in 2026 R1; public first attempt 51% in 2026 R1.
